sourcePath: sets/the-foul-realms/beta/Chaos Brawl - The Foul Realms - Beta.mse-set

cards.name: Shut up
cards.rulesText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature loses all abilities and can’t attack.
cards.flavorText: “Hoit die Goschn, sonst sperr i di ei.”

cards.name: MAGAZIN!
cards.rulesText: Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
cards.flavorText: “The louder you shout, the faster you get ammo.”

cards.name: Magical Bucket Pump
cards.rulesText:
Equipped creature has “{T}: Tap target creature.”
Equip {2}
cards.flavorText: “Ha! — Gaaayyyy!”

cards.name: Wedding Ring
cards.flavorText: “For better or for worse.”

cards.name: Unpleasant Surprise
cards.rulesText: Return target creature to its owner’s hand. Its controller loses 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card.
cards.flavorText: “He had faced demons, dragons, and worse. Nothing prepared him for this.”

cards.name: Dungeon Master
cards.rulesText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, roll a d20.
1–5 | Create a Treasure token.
6–15 | Create a Beer token.
16–19 | Draw a card.
20 | You may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
cards.flavorText: “You enter the tavern. Roll a Perception check.”

cards.name: Marlene, the Leader
cards.rulesText:
Vigilance
Other Squadmembers you control get +0/+1.
cards.flavorText: “Someone has to keep the squad together.”

cards.name: Robin, the Pusher
cards.rulesText:
Haste
Other Squadmembers you control get +1/+0.
cards.flavorText: “Push! Push! Push!”

cards.name: Tobias, the Grenadier
cards.rulesText:
Deathtouch
Other Squadmembers you control get +1/+0.
cards.flavorText: “Attention, bomb incoming!”

cards.name: Max, the Sniper
cards.rulesText:
Flying
Other Squadmembers you control get +1/+0.
cards.flavorText: “Target acquired.”

cards.name: Let’s Fucking Go
cards.rulesText: Target creature gets +3/+0 and gains haste until end of turn. You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “Kennst an Satz mit imi? – Wos scheiß imi!”

cards.name: Summon the Squad
cards.rulesText: Search your library for Marlene, the Leader, Robin, the Pusher, Max, the Sniper, and Tobias, the Grenadier. Put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.flavorText: “Squad up. We’re going in.”

cards.name: Just Do it
cards.rulesText: Roll a d20. Sacrifice that many lands divided by two, rounded down. For each land sacrificed this way, draw a card and deal one damage to a target creature or planeswalker. You may put land cards drawn this way onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “I dare you.”

cards.name: Homemade Paranoia
cards.rulesText: Reveal the top three cards of your library. If a creature card is revealed this way, put a creature card from among them into your hand. Otherwise, put all land cards revealed this way onto the battlefield tapped. Put the rest into your graveyard.
cards.flavorText: “Peter und Peter, von früh bis später”

cards.name: Flooded Palace
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {U} or {W} to your mana pool.)
As Flooded Palace enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Flooded Palace enters the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Duskmire
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {U} or {B} to your mana pool.)
As Duskmire enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Duskmire enters the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Reefgarden
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {G} or {U} to your mana pool.)
As Reefgarden enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Reefgarden enters the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: The Stoned Peaks
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {R} or {G} to your mana pool.)
As The Stoned Peaks enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, The Stoned Peaks enters the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: The Blessed Hideaway
cards.rulesText:
Whenever a multicolored spell is cast, choose one —
• Create a Food token.
• Create a Beer token.
• Create a Treasure token.
cards.flavorText: “Beyond the mountains lies a place where time stands still, old friends become brothers, and every year we return home.”

cards.name: Roadside Distraction
cards.rulesText:
Target creature can’t block this turn.
Draw a card.
cards.flavorText:
“HAHAHAHA—
WATCH THE ROAD!”

cards.name: Have a Beer, or Three
cards.rulesText: Roll a d20. If the result is odd, create three Expired Beer tokens and lose 3 life. If the result is even, create three Beer tokens. If the result is 20, also draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “For his friends, he always has the ‘special’ beer.”

cards.name: Draft Tap
cards.rulesText:
When Draft Tap enters the battlefield, create three Beer tokens.
Whenever you sacrifice a Beer token, put an additional Drunken counter on the creature it targets.
cards.flavorText: “Fresh from the tap just tastes better.”

cards.name: Fill Em Up
cards.rulesText:
Choose one —
• Put Drunken counters on target creature equal to its Drunken Tolerance plus one.
• Deal 6 damage to target planeswalker.
cards.flavorText: “One more. He can still see straight.”

cards.name: Critical (S)hit
cards.rulesText: Destroy target tapped creature.
cards.flavorText: “Turns out nonstop feasting comes with natural consequences.”

cards.name: Stoned Speech
cards.rulesText: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
cards.flavorText: “I’m fucking stoned, but I’m gonna give a speech.”

cards.name: Designated Driver
cards.rulesText:
Designated Driver gets −1/−0 for each Beer and each drunken creature on the battlefield.
Designated Driver crews Vehicles as though its power were at least 3.
cards.flavorText: “Someone has to get everyone home safely.”

cards.name: A Place to Stay
cards.rulesText:
Search your library for a Location card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
You gain 2 life.
cards.flavorText: “One day, these fields would hold their home, their stories, and their children’s memories.”

cards.name: Hexenschuss
cards.rulesText: Destroy target attacking creature.
cards.flavorText: “He’s been bitten by wolves and burned by dragons. Nothing hurt like a Hexenschuss.”

cards.name: Tavern Regular
cards.rulesText: When Tavern Regular enters the battlefield, you may reveal a card from your hand. If you do, create a Beer token.
cards.flavorText: “Nobody knows his name. Everybody knows his order.”

cards.name: Tavern Bouncer
cards.rulesText: {T}: Tap target drunken creature.
cards.flavorText: “Act stupid, get bounced.”

cards.name: Tavern Medic
cards.rulesText: {T}: Remove any number of Drunken counters from target creature. If it’s a creature you control, you gain 1 life for each counter removed this way. Otherwise, you lose 1 life for each counter removed this way.
cards.flavorText: “We need a medic! ...or just water.”

cards.name: Edi, the Beerpig
cards.rulesText:
Kicker—Sacrifice one or more Beer (You may sacrifice one or more Beer in addition to any other costs as you cast this spell.)
If Edi was kicked, it enters with two +1/+1 counters on it for each Beer sacrificed to cast it.
If one or more Drunken counters would be put on Edi, instead put that many +1/+1 counters on it.
cards.flavorText: “Edi is so massive, beer doesn’t even count as alcoholic.”

cards.name: Goner
cards.rulesText:
Goner enters tapped.
If Goner would be exiled from anywhere, put it into its owner’s graveyard instead.

cards.name: Recycle
cards.rulesText:
Exile X cards from your graveyard. Create a Treasure token for each card exiled this way.
If X is 4 or greater, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “Nothing is wasted. It merely becomes something else.”

cards.name: Closing Hour
cards.rulesText: Return all tokens to their owners’ hands.
cards.flavorText: “Closing time. No refunds for unfinished business.”

cards.name: Always With Us
cards.rulesText: Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a spell or ability, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “We’ll always have a place for them at the fire.”

cards.name: Innkeepers Daugther
cards.rulesText: {T}: Create a Treasure token for each drunken creature on the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: “Be careful! She’s seventeen.”

cards.name: Hoard Beast
cards.rulesText:
When Hoard Beast enters the battlefield, create a Food token, a Beer token, and a Treasure token.
The Hoard Beast’s power is equal to the number of artifact tokens on the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: “It’s only a kid’s tale until things disappear overnight.”

cards.name: Nadine, Sirens’ Origin
cards.rulesText:
Flying
Other Sirens you control get +1/+1 and have ward {1}.
cards.flavorText: “Four wings, able to fly, faster than sound beneath the waves —that’s the Sirens’ origin.”

cards.name: The Mind
cards.rulesText: You and target opponent each search your library for a card and reveal it. If those cards share a mana value or card type, put them into their owners’ hands. Otherwise, each player shuffles. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “They’re definitely thinking the same thing.”

cards.name: Boosted Excitement
cards.rulesText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control three or more creatures, it also gains hexproof until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “NO WAY. YOU ACTUALLY GOT IT!”

cards.name: Annoying Running Gag
cards.rulesText:
When you draw this card, if you control four or more lands, cast it without paying its mana cost.
Draw three cards, then discard X cards, where X is the number of times you’ve cast this spell this game.
When it resolves, shuffle it into its owner’s library.

cards.name: Provoker
cards.rulesText: Whenever Provoker enters the battlefield or attacks, put an Obsession counter on target creature an opponent controls.
cards.flavorText: “I don’t want to start anything, but…”

cards.name: Frozen Taps
cards.rulesText:
Artifacts can’t be tapped.
When there are ten or more artifacts on the battlefield, sacrifice Frozen Taps.
cards.flavorText: “Everyone blamed the barkeeper. He blamed a spirit.”

cards.name: Experimental Invention
cards.rulesText:
Flying
Whenever Experimental Invention deals combat damage to a player, look at the top card of your library and the top card of that player’s library.
Crew 1
cards.flavorText: “He mainly uses it to spy on the neighbor’s daughter.”

cards.name: Hosn Owe
cards.rulesText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature, nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
cards.flavorText: “He lost so many games, they started calling him Hosn Owe.”

cards.name: Improvised Escape
cards.rulesText: Exile target creature you control. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner’s control at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.flavorText: “He used the first thing he could reach.”

cards.name: Strange Allergic Reaction
cards.rulesText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature is a 1/1 green Plant creature with “{T}: Add {G}.”
cards.flavorText: “He never thought driving through the fields would cause an allergic reaction.”

cards.name: Friend or Foe
cards.rulesText:
Your opponent chooses friend or foe.
Friend — You draw 3 cards and they draw 1. You both lose 2 life.
Foe — You each roll a d20. If your opponent’s roll is 3 or more higher, they draw 2 cards and lose 4 life. Otherwise, you do. If a player rolls 20, they draw 4 cards and lose 6 life instead.
cards.flavorText: “Only cowards choose friend.”

cards.name: The Fallen
cards.rulesText:
The Fallen enters the battlefield tapped with a Drunken counter on it.
If you would discard The Fallen, put it onto the battlefield tapped with a Drunken counter on it instead.
cards.flavorText: “We found him eventually. From then on, he was the Hifolate.”
